record.title: Failures Submitting Self-Serve Configuration Changes for Grafana Cloud Logs in AWS Sweden (prod-eu-north-0)

updates.body: Between approximately 23:00 UTC on September 12, 2026 and 09:12 UTC on September 14, 2026, some Grafana Cloud Logs customers in AWS Sweden (prod-eu-north-0) may have intermittently experienced errors when submitting configuration changes through the Cloud Portal. This has been resolved, and configuration change requests are being accepted normally.
